dataset: Digitraffic Marine – AIS vessel locations and vessel metadata (API v1)
description: Latest AIS class A position reports and static voyage data (name, ship type, destination, draught) received by the Finnish AIS shore network, covering Finnish waters and the surrounding Baltic Sea.

coverage.geographic: Finnish coastal waters, the Gulf of Finland, the Archipelago Sea, the Gulf of Bothnia and the northern Baltic Sea within range of Finnish AIS base stations (plus Lake Saimaa). Not a global feed.
coverage.temporal: Latest known position per vessel; only positions reported within the last 60 minutes are shown.

updateCadence.upstream: Continuous; API responses are cached upstream for about one minute

envVars.name: DIGITRAFFIC_USER
envVars.description: Value of the Digitraffic-User request header identifying this deployment (e.g. "MyOrg/WorldMap 1.0"). Never put personal data in it. Defaults to "world-intelligence-map/1.0".

auth.setup: No registration is needed. Digitraffic asks every client to send a Digitraffic-User header naming the organisation and/or application (no personal data) and to accept gzip; requests without the header are limited to 60 per minute per IP. Set DIGITRAFFIC_USER to identify your own deployment.

attribution: Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, license CC 4.0 BY

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
license.notes: Terms of service: https://www.digitraffic.fi/en/terms-of-service/ – Fintraffic's open data is CC BY 4.0; credit as "Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, license CC 4.0 BY", link to the original where possible and state modifications. This application filters to recent positions and decodes AIS code values.

limitations: Regional coverage only: vessels outside the reach of Finnish AIS base stations are not present, so the layer says nothing about the rest of the Baltic or the world.
Class A transponders only; Digitraffic removes all fishing vessels (AIS type 30) and collapses detailed ship-type codes into decade classes (e.g. 70–79 → 70).

Name, destination, draught, ship type and navigational status are typed in by the crew and broadcast unverified: they are often outdated, abbreviated or wrong, and AIS positions can be spoofed or switched off.
Positions older than 60 minutes are not shown; a vessel that leaves coverage simply stops updating.
confidenceNotes: No per-record confidence is published. Records are self-reported AIS broadcasts relayed by Fintraffic without verification; the AIS position-accuracy flag is passed through as an attribute.

retention.note: Latest position per vessel plus the recent path; observations are purged after 2 days.

layers.name: Vessels – Baltic (AIS)
layers.description: Ships in Finnish waters and the northern Baltic Sea from Fintraffic's AIS network, identified exactly as broadcast (MMSI, AIS name and ship type). Regional coverage, positions from the last hour.
